description: Fix all DataTables TN/18 'Incorrect column count' errors across admin pages and dashboards. The bug: when a @forelse/@empty renders no rows, the is empty and DataTables cannot infer column count, triggering TN/18. Fix: add a No records inside every @empty block, where N = the number of cells in that table's . Also fix hardcoded fixed-width stat grids in admin pages to be responsive. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: READ context.json and this FEAT file first.

PAYOUTS — resources/views/pages/admin/payouts.blade.php: (1) Find @empty inside #payouts-table tbody. Add: No payout requests found. (2) Find the 4-column summary stat grid (grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) inline). Add class payout-stats to that div. Append a

BOOKINGS — resources/views/pages/admin/bookings.blade.php: (1) Find @empty inside #bookings-table tbody. Add: No bookings found. (2) Find the status stats bar (grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) inline). Add class booking-stats. Append: .booking-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)!important;} @media(min-width:768px){.booking-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important;}}

BLOG — resources/views/pages/admin/blog.blade.php: (1) Find @empty inside #blog-table tbody. Add: No blog posts found. (2) Find the 3-column stats grid (grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) inline). Add class blog-stats. Append: .blog-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;} @media(min-width:640px){.blog-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)!important;}}

GROUP SESSIONS ADMIN — resources/views/pages/admin/group-sessions/index.blade.php: Find @empty inside #group-sessions-table tbody. Add: No group sessions found. The .stats-grid class is already responsive (defined in admin.blade.php as repeat(2,1fr) → repeat(4,1fr) at 1200px).

STUDENT DASHBOARD — resources/views/pages/dashboard/student.blade.php: (1) Read the file to find #student-sessions-table. Count in its thead — confirmed 8 columns (Tutor, Subject, Date, Duration, Paid, Status, Review, Actions). Find its @empty block. Add: No sessions yet. (2) Find #student-payments-table. Count its columns. Add matching colspan empty row.

PARENT DASHBOARD — resources/views/pages/dashboard/parent.blade.php: (1) #parent-upcoming-sessions-table — confirmed 9 columns (Tutor, Child, Subject, Date, Duration, Paid, Status, Review, Actions). Find @empty. Add: No sessions yet. (2) #parent-payments-table — read the file, count , add matching empty row. (3) #parent-refunds-table — same.

OTHER ADMIN PAGES — For each of these, READ the file, count <th> columns in each DataTable's <thead>, and add the matching colspan empty row in @empty: resources/views/pages/admin/users.blade.php (#users-table), resources/views/pages/admin/categories.blade.php (#categories-table), resources/views/pages/admin/subjects.blade.php (#subjects-table), resources/views/pages/admin/clinics.blade.php (#clinics-table), resources/views/pages/admin/clinic-show.blade.php (#clinic-bookings-table), resources/views/pages/admin/library.blade.php (#library-table). For any stat grids using repeat(3,1fr) or repeat(4,1fr) inline without responsive breakpoints, add the same pattern: 1-col at mobile, 2-col at 480px, N-col at 768px.

DATATABLES ASSETS — resources/views/partials/datatables-assets.blade.php: Inside the existing @media(max-width:768px){} block, add: table.dataTable { width: 100% !important; min-width: unset !important; }
Commit all changes with message: 'fix(datatables): empty-state colspan fixes TN/18; responsive admin stat grids'
